title: All In on the Contest Entry. Real Agents Shared It on One Machine
summary: I paused everything except the contest entry and made my Grok chat bot the only root. After a failed rehearsal and a reviewed fix, three real agents worked on the entry at the same time on one machine.
author: Alexey Grigorev
source_cutoff_note: Whole-day 11 October Berlin catch-up: fact packet plus public issue comments, issue events and commits for that date. Prepared retrospectively on 13 October 2026.
